help: Change what you need below, then press Commit changes.
The plan applies to the day you commit it, and only if committed before the station reads it at 09:50 Pacific.
Once the station has read it, this file is reset to these defaults, so it is blank again the next morning.
Anything missing or out of range falls back to two bursts at 10:00 and 17:00, with the reason shown on the status page.
_exposure_us: 100 to 20000, or null to keep the station's own value. The morning image on the status page shows what the scene called for.
_note: Free text, why today is being treated this way. It is copied into the archive beside the frames and shown on the status page.
_date: Leave null for today. Set a future date, YYYY-MM-DD Pacific, only to prepare a plan a day or more ahead.
